name: Pay in lieu of notice (สินจ้างแทนการบอกกล่าวล่วงหน้า s.17/1; ค่าชดเชยพิเศษแทนการบอกกล่าวล่วงหน้า ss.120 para.2, 121 para.2)
authority: Labour Protection Act s.17 para.2 (No.2 B.E.2551) and s.17/1 (No.7 B.E.2562), Council of State consolidation through No.9 B.E.2568, https://searchlaw.ocs.go.th/council-of-state/#/public/doc/ZGN3NXk0eENvNjBSdjRnT2NsdjFTQT09 (register TH-EXIT-04): an employer ending an indefinite contract gives notice at or before a payday, effective on the next payday; without it the employer pays the wages from the removal to the day notice would have taken effect, on the day the employee leaves. Priced from the notice date (exit fact `notice_given_on`; unrecorded is no notice) through the payday after the first payday on or after it, monthly wage over each calendar month's days (`payday_notice_days`, `notice_monthly_wages`). No notice is owed on a s.119 dismissal (s.17 last para.; exit fact `dismissed_for_cause`), at a fixed term's expiry (s.17 para.1; END_OF_CONTRACT), on resignation or retirement. The line also carries the special severance in lieu of notice (ค่าชดเชยพิเศษแทนการบอกกล่าวล่วงหน้า) of s.120 para.2 — 30 days’ last wage (the last 30 working days’ wages for wages by results per unit) to an employee who will not move where the relocation notice was not posted 30 days ahead (exit facts `relocation_objection`, `relocation_notice_posted`) — and of s.121 para.2 — 60 days’ last wage (60 working days’ for wages by results) where an employer terminating for machinery or technology restructuring (`technology_restructuring`) gave less than 60 days’ notice (`technology_notice_60_days`); s.121 para.1 excludes s.17 para.2 there, so no s.17/1 amount is added. Readings: a daily-paid leaver's wages to the effective date depend on the days they would have worked, so HR enters that amount. Not modelled: Civil and Commercial Code s.583 summary dismissal other than a s.119 cause. Tax: a one-time payment on leaving (DG Notification on income tax No.45 cl.1(ง), https://www.rd.go.th/3213.html) withheld with severance under scheme SEVERANCE_TAX (Revenue Code s.50(1) para.3, s.48(5)); outside Order P.96/2543's regular method (PIT), the Social Security Act s.5 wage (not pay for work) and the Employee Welfare Fund wage.
